class ScannerWrapper:
    def __init__(self):
        pass

    def readInt(self):
        return int(input())

def SaveRotates(num):
    global minNumRotates
    if minNumRotates == 0:
        minNumRotates = num
    else:
        minNumRotates = min(minNumRotates, num)

def CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset, isInterval):
    global n, k, kbeg, kend, numRotates
    if tmin[0] > n or tmin[1] > n:
        return
    if (tmin[0] <= n and tmax[0] >= n) or (tmin[1] <= n and tmax[1] >= n):
        if (tmax[0] < n and side == 1) or (tmax[1] < n and side == 0):
            SaveRotates(numRotates + 1)
        else:
            SaveRotates(numRotates)
        return
    if koffset == k:
        return

    if isInterval:
        if kbeg[koffset] == kend[koffset]:
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, False)
            numRotates += 1
            CalcRotates(1 - side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, False)
            numRotates -= 1
        else:
            delta = kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset]
            tmin[side] += delta
            tmax[side] += delta
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, False)
            tmin[side] -= delta
            tmax[side] -= delta

            tmax[side] += delta
            tmax[1 - side] += delta
            numRotates += 1
            CalcRotates(1 - side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, False)
            numRotates -= 1
            tmax[side] -= delta
            tmax[1 - side] -= delta

            tmax[side] += delta
            tmin[1 - side] += 1
            tmax[1 - side] += delta - 1
            numRotates += 2
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, False)
            numRotates -= 2
            tmax[side] -= delta
            tmin[1 - side] -= 1
            tmax[1 - side] -= delta - 1
    else:
        delta = kbeg[koffset] - noffset
        tmin[side] += delta
        tmax[side] += delta
        CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kbeg[koffset], koffset, True)
        tmin[side] -= delta
        tmax[side] -= delta

n = 0
k = 0
numRotates = 0
minNumRotates = 0

scanner = ScannerWrapper()
n = scanner.readInt()
k = scanner.readInt()

kbeg = [0] * k
kend = [0] * k

for i in range(k):
    kbeg[i] = scanner.readInt()
    kend[i] = scanner.readInt()

tmin = [0, 0]
tmax = [0, 0]

CalcRotates(0, tmin, tmax, 0, 0, False)

if minNumRotates > 0:
    print("Full")
    print(minNumRotates)
else:
    print("Hungry")
